readme: Beacon Capital Stewardship — Synthetic Quarterly Data Extract
Snapshot as of 2025-12-31  |  Fiscal Year 2026 To-Date (2025-07-01 through 2025-12-31)
THIS IS 100% SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA created for a take-home assessment exercise.
Beacon Capital Stewardship, Beacon Pension Trust (BPT), Beacon Legacy Endowment (BLE), and all
manager names below are invented and do not represent any real institution, fund, or person.
SCENARIO
Beacon Capital Stewardship is the fictional CIO office overseeing two pools of capital:
- Beacon Pension Trust (BPT)  — a defined benefit pension plan
- Beacon Legacy Endowment (BLE) — a pooled endowment fund
Each fund invests across a common menu of asset classes and underlying managers, but holds
different dollar amounts and different policy (target) allocations reflecting its own risk profile.
FILE NAMING / FYTD CONVENTION
Files are named <QuarterEndDate>_FYTD.xlsx, mirroring how many asset-owner reporting platforms
export data: each file is a fiscal-year-to-date snapshot as of a quarter end. The fiscal year runs
July 1 - June 30. This file contains every fiscal quarter from FY2026 Q1 through Q2.
Open all four files together to reconstruct the full FY2026 year, or use any single file's
FYTD columns/rows for a cumulative view as of that quarter.
UNITS
All market values are in USD millions ($M) unless otherwise labeled. Returns are in percent (%).
Excess return columns are in basis points (bps) = (return difference x 100).
SHEETS IN THIS WORKBOOK
Fund_Summary        Fund-level AUM waterfall (beginning MV, cash flows, fees, gain/loss,
ending MV) and total-fund performance vs. policy benchmark, by quarter.
Asset_Allocation    Fund x asset-class detail: market value, % of total, policy target %,
variance to target, assigned benchmark, and returns (QTD & FYTD), by quarter.
Manager_Detail      Fund x asset-class x underlying-manager detail: market value, returns,
vehicle type, inception date, by quarter. Manager weights are shared
across funds (same manager roster); dollar amounts differ by fund size.
Cash_Flow_Detail    Quarterly contribution/gift, benefit payment/distribution, and fee detail
by fund.
Benchmarks_Reference Reference table of the benchmark assigned to each asset class.
RAW_Export_Extract  A deliberately messy, source-system-style export (metadata header block,
cryptic column IDs, blank spacer rows) covering a subset of this quarter's
Asset_Allocation data for Beacon Pension Trust. This mirrors how data often
actually arrives from performance/reporting platforms. Parsing it is optional
but rewarded — it's a realistic stand-in for messy source data.
NOTES FOR RECONCILIATION
- Ending MV = Beginning MV + Net Cash Flow + Investment Gain/(Loss).
- Net Cash Flow = Contributions/Gifts + Benefit Payments/Distributions + Admin Fees +
Investment Management Fees (fees are negative).
- Neither fund rebalances intra-year in this dataset — policy targets are targets, not
forced weights, so actual allocation will drift away from target as markets move.
- Within each asset class, the sum of manager-level market values reconciles exactly to the
asset class total; the sum of asset-class totals reconciles exactly to the fund total.
- 'Policy Benchmark Return' for a fund = the weighted average of each asset class's benchmark
return, weighted by that asset class's POLICY TARGET weight (not the actual weight). This is
intentional — comparing actual performance to this benchmark separates allocation effects
from manager-selection effects, if you want to go there.
